lines: {target}? Sound travels farther than sense. I would keep milk and bottles ready.
If anyone heads for Deep Dark, tell them: Walk soft and do not open every chest. I will be at the brewing stand.
Sculk hears what pride forgets. I will remember that when I set out the bottles.
Deep Dark is no small story. Some hurts reach deeper than skin.
I will remember Deep Dark as darkness that listens back. I will keep a remedy close.

Pointed stone makes every stumble serious. I will remember that when I set out the bottles.
Dripstone Caves is no small story. Some hurts reach deeper than skin.
I will remember Dripstone Caves as a cave that bites from both directions. I will keep a remedy close.

I will remember Lush Caves as a cave trying very hard to look harmless. I will keep a remedy close.
